Few elements, exceptional legibility. No photographic rendering.

Subject: Exactly one REAL basketball player, Kerry Blackshear Jr (ケリー・ブラックシアー・ジュニア), selected randomly from players named in the article, drawn in an energetic defensive slide, knees flexed, torso angled forward in three-quarter view, eyes tracking an imagined opponent outside the frame. His right-side placement and broad athletic silhouette anchor the image; one arm extends to the right with a clear natural open hand, the other arm bent with a natural open hand. Use an above-knee composition with head and both hands fully inside the image. No other people. No ball is necessary. This is a conceptual playing illustration, not a recreation of any documented game or event.

Official appearance reference already inspected: https://g-crane-thunders.jp/roster/players/detail/kerry-blackshear-jr and its portrait https://g-crane-thunders.bl.kuroco-img.app/v=1789375653/files/user/images/roster/players/detail_2027/kerry-blackshear-jr/fv.jpg . Accurately represent his very short close-cropped black hair, broad forehead, pronounced brows, wide nose, full lips, strong broad oval/square jaw, short close-trimmed beard along the cheeks and jaw and chin, neat thin moustache, muscular shoulders, sturdy tall build and dark skin. Render his face with carefully readable ivory/gray highlights and hatched shadows, not a black silhouette. Do not substitute an invented generic player. His jersey is plain dark basketball kit with restrained ivory/lime edging, no text, no numbers, no logos, no sponsor marks. A dark sleeve on the left arm is acceptable. Never paste or reproduce an official photograph; all pixels must look hand-drawn.

Composition: Text block occupying the left 54%, single player's dynamic defensive illustration on right 46%, no overlaps obscuring typography. Upper-left small publication title and date. Below it a medium lime scope label. Then a very bold ivory 「群馬」 and a HUGE lime 「5戦全勝」 as the main headline, with rough brush accents. A clean, smaller ivory stat line below; keep it explicitly a team statistic. Bottom-left restrained AI disclosure. Keep all type and both hands within 5% safe margins. Energetic broad lime brush stroke behind the player, sparse ink specks; avoid clutter. This must resemble the approved B-culver-black-lime-v3 style in the conversation, but do NOT carry over Culver's face, name, jersey, shooting pose, score, or statistics.

「直近5試合｜10/31〜11/13」
「群馬」
「5戦全勝」

Do not claim a season record, league rank, individual points, individual participation, or a particular decisive play. Do not add the player's name or personal statistics anywhere.
Avoid: team/league/manufacturer logos, sponsor text, watermarks, official photos, photorealism, invented players, a ball-only scene, extra digits/fingers/arms, cropped hands/head/text, unsupported data, garbled Japanese, visual clutter.

CORRECTION 1 (only correction)
Edit image 1, the generated black-and-lime basketball thumbnail. Image 2 is Kerry Blackshear Jr's OFFICIAL portrait, appearance reference only, NOT an image to paste. Make this one correction pass, preserving the existing Japanese copy exactly, the palette, ink-and-engraving hand-drawn style, overall left-text/right-player layout, the defensive pose, plain logo-free jersey and all content.

Correct the player's likeness using image 2 carefully: replace the taller curly hair with his VERY SHORT CLOSE-CROPPED BUZZ CUT, scalp-close with subtly visible fine dark texture, not high curls. Reduce the full dense beard to his neat SHORT TRIMMED jaw/cheek beard and thin moustache, matching the portrait's facial contour, broad forehead, strong brows, wide nose and full lips. Keep the image explicitly an ink illustration with hatching, not photorealistic. Keep the existing defensive pose and facial gaze direction, but match the real man's face and head shape more closely. Do not reproduce the official picture, logos, sponsors, or folded-arm pose.

Correct safe margins: shrink the entire foreground layout slightly (about 92–94% of current size) within the SAME landscape 16:9 canvas, extend only the near-black brush-textured background as necessary, so ALL headline edges, the top of the head, and especially the extended hand and all five fingertips are visibly surrounded by safe margin (at least 4% of canvas). Keep the text large and the original composition; no cramped fingers at the right edge and no overlapping the 70.6 line. Do not cut off head, hands or any text. Normal anatomically correct five-digit hands.

群馬
